notes.title: 🎉 The Fur and Fangs Demo is Here! 🦴🐾
notes.content: [p]Defend your land against feral mice, level up with powerful upgrades, and test your skills in this new roguelike. Whether you're dodging fireballs or hunting for cheese, every run brings something new.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s in the Demo:[/b][/p][p]Fast-paced combat with scaling difficulty[/p][p]Upgrade system featuring damage, health, and HP regeneration boosts via a cheese-based progression[/p][p]Bone-collecting madness that fuels your power[/p][p]A taste of the randomness and replayability the full game will deliver. Try it now & let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any bugs please let us know, we are a very small dev team and may have missed a few bugs.[/p][p]Your feedback will shape the future development of the game. Drop your thoughts in the community hub and add the full game to your wish list![/p]
